Name: Connection, handshake and telemetry
Subsystem: The UDP transport, the connection handshake, identity and the 30 Hz state stream
Purpose: Everything below this reads the robot's own telemetry. A handshake that half works, a state rate that is not 30 Hz, or a link that quietly resends produces results that look like subsystem faults and are not. This is also the reading the safety check before every movement test compares against.
ExpectedTelemetry: connected, identity received, more than 20 RobotState at about 30 Hz, nothing pending
ExpectedPhysical: He sits still, his backpack light is on, and nothing about him changes for 20 seconds.
Prerequisites: the robot is on and its light is on
no other application is connected to it
InterruptedReason: the link to the robot was lost while the check was running
